content: Bulus te ge' Kundǝlǝn ki Mal is su Loma
Nǝ kǝndi ɗǝ hilya ɗǝ su' Italiya ge' kundǝlǝn ki malu, is ta' Bulus a toh ɗǝ bal mul kǝndǝ' dlom ne' na mi' ginǝ ge' kǝs kǝndǝ' mbalen u, mulshin Yuliyas, nǝm age' mi' kǝndǝ' dlom ki domga ki Agusta.
Nǝn te ge' kundǝlǝn te' Adalamatiya mul lyap su'ge' gatlen a malgǝn Asiya u, in gob lǝti, a Alistalkus mul Tasolonika won ki atl ki Makidoniya, tine' mi.
Nǝ lucilu in mbǝci a Sidom. Yuliyas ne ippǝli Bulus ulki zoki, is za'ti tǝs su ma yelǝnsi wasi gaki sǝ' ɗǝlti ɗa.
Nǝn tlǝ aki age' kundǝllǝn ki mallu gaki ki etǝl tlǝtl tetǝn kina inǝn, in gandǝl tu kal calgatl ki Kublus.
Nǝn peɗǝ ge bal mallu nǝ nja nǝ atl ki Kilikiya nǝki Bampiliya u, in mbǝ'ci Mila a ge' atl ki Likiya.
Bal mul kǝndǝ' dlom mbi kundǝlǝn ki Iskandaliya mul lǝ' ge' altki Italiya, illa'mi a giɓi.
In lǝm mutti ami lǝti' ten ten, nǝ ngeskǝn mǝ mbǝci nja nǝ Kinidas. Nǝ bǝ yetǝl a zamiwai u, in gandǝli akal calgatl ki Kalita nja nǝ Salmoni.
Nǝ nges kǝn mǝ ɓew nja nǝ bǝgasi in mbǝci ge' lu u nǝ ɗǝ mbeti hwu' ki zoki, nja nǝ gatlt ki Lisiya.
Nǝ dǝmniki lǝtisi a dlewtwai u, lǝti sima i' dǝm ulki ci' ɓanti, cinkǝ ngaptibima a ɓewyi, i Bulus dǝlisi kǝm,
I' ulsisu, “Ami yenti lǝtinǝn u nǝn dǝmti ulki ki ci' bulti, bǝ hwotl lǝɓa nǝ kundǝlǝn ki malu katlwai, nǝ dli inǝn ma.”
Amma bal mul ki ndǝ'dlom a ndǝ' nǝ ulnǝ Bulus dlǝmi u wai, tǝ gǝtli nǝ kub shilǝn ki mul kundǝlǝni nǝ mul dǝtl kundǝlǝn u.

Nǝ dǝm niki lu hwuntu a mbuni kundǝlǝn i' sǝ' ci watlǝn agimbi wai u, mbalǝn diɓǝli is mbǝl shilǝn sǝ'tlǝ ɗǝki, kowongi si ngashti bi mbǝci tya Ponokiya sǝ'dǝm tya ka. Age' lu hwu ki calgalt ki Kalita, gunǝ ɗǝya' bǝgasi ki alewa nǝ kudu u.
Bundǝlǝn a dlǝlka
Nǝ yetǝlu gop hotti te'ɗi ten ten u, tǝn lati mbadl ki mbalǝnisi sambi ulnǝ si lyamti u i; is dǝl kundǝlǝn ki mali nǝ kali nǝ zhim dom is bǝli tya malgǝn calgalt ki Kalita nja nǝ bigasi.
Alǝm dǝmtwai, i bal etǝl tlǝtoh ge' calgatli gunǝ ɗǝ mbeti ki Yulokilidon.
Nǝ etǝl li' ku ndǝllǝn ki malisi u, hal taman nga'ti etǝli ndan wai, in zaki katl i etǝlli si go' jakǝnmi.
Nǝn bǝli kal yakǝn calgatlon u mulshin Kauda, lu unǝ etǝl bosɗa u, nǝngeskǝn mi dlǝl ya kǝn kundǝllǝni.

Is sul yakǝn kundǝllǝnni swa ge' bali u, si kupɓanti is kǝ'kǝndǝ zhim is gandǝl bal kundǝllǝni ɗa, gaki ɓa suge tisǝn ki bǝgasi ki Siltis mul sǝga' mus lǝɓa, iki is shit luluti ki tǝn kǝndǝlǝnnisikǝ tǝn gaki tǝ yetǝl jakǝn kundǝlǝni siɗa.
Gaki bundǝlǝn mul ndǝlti ɗǝ kundǝlǝnni eye', nǝ citlkǝlu i mi' ndǝtl kundǝllǝni gop utti kaya taka swage'mal.
Nǝ mutti maki nǝ toh wasan kǝn sǝdla' ul kyautǝn ki kundǝllǝni taka.
Mutti di ɓǝli mayen cin nǝ cadlǝllwai, sai bal yetǝlon kǝn ɗǝ li'ti mi, in pe'kǝl mbadl ki pe'ti.

Nǝ dǝm niki alǝm mutti ba ɗap ulki ɗami, i Bulus hilya gal adlom ɗa si i'usu: “Mbalǝn, tǝ'ka kumǝn shilǝn i u tǝn bǝ zakǝn calgatl ki Kalita wai u, da kǝ'kǝn ndati ge' ulkǝ ci' bultuwai nǝ hwol lǝɓa u wai.
Ammi ndǝllǝn mbadli, gaki nǝgu mullǝn gudǝl nǝm kǝn gǝtl age' kini wai, sai dai tǝ hwol ku ndǝlǝni.
Age' gaski hwuɗi mul shikǝn ki Lya shilǝn nǝ ami. Ami zheli ki Lya kǝni, ti ami pǝlitti bǝna. I' shin mul shinkǝ wassuɗi tǝm mbǝ makǝni.
I usu, ‘Bǝkum ɓantwai Bulus. Kǝn dlǝlti kina ɗǝ Kaisal, i ngu Lya a kumki ta ndǝgi mus yelǝnsi lǝtwagi sǝn pe'ti.’
Gaki nǝgu ndǝllǝn mbadlwakǝn, kini mbalǝn, a la' mbatl nǝ Lya tǝn ussu, kan u nǝs dlǝmi u, nǝgu tǝ pǝldli.
Amma nǝ ngeti etǝl nǝn la'timin tya tǝn bǝgasi.”
Age' gas ki mutti kutl nǝ upsi asi dǝtl mi age' dlǝlka ki Adaliya, abal gasi mi'dǝtl kundǝlǝni siyenti mǝ ɓal nja nǝ bǝgasi i.
Is cimbǝl lolu' ki mali is mbi asan kutl cen nǝm nǝ kutl lǝbi lop. Nǝn lǝ kina ten ngulen u is cimbǝli ɗaɗanu is mbi lolu tisi asan kutl lǝbi nǝtapsi.
Gaki kitǝli' li'ti zǝnga, is la' dom gudǝl upsi ki kal kundǝlǝni, is shilǝn nǝ Lya tǝ lu dlewti ɗǝ cilti.
Mi'dǝtl kundǝlǝni is ngau kitǝl ɗǝ ge' kundǝlǝni, hal sashi' yakǝn kundǝlǝn age' mali, gaki tǝ yen dli kǝnǝ sǝ shit dom ki bikina ki kundǝlǝni ni is za'si.
I Bulus ul bal mul kǝndǝ dlom ki Loma su nǝ mi'kǝndǝ dlom, in mbalǝn i adlǝl ge' kundǝlǝn uwai u, ka mbǝ'cini ki' pe' twai.”
I mi'kǝndǝ dlomi is ɓaɓatl zhim ki tǝn yakǝn kundǝlǝni is za' kundǝlǝni i mal kami.
Nǝ lu ɓal nja tǝ cilu. I Bulus ulsisu sǝn na'ɗam ulǝn, “A sǝti mutti kutl nǝ upsi ngu, aki dǝp ki ɓutti, bǝ ka ɗamǝn ulǝn wai.”
Gaki nǝgu ami shetl kini ki'ɗamini, gaki dliwakǝn, gaki nǝgu mulǝn gudǝl nǝm medlǝn ki gawakǝn kǝn gǝltwai.
Nǝtl dlǝmi nǝgu u, i' kan biledi i' shilǝn nǝ Lya akina wasan, i' chali it gop ɗamti.
Musswasǝn is kum ndǝlti, sima is ɗam ulki ɗami.
Musi nǝn age' kundǝlǝni mi kutl cen lop nǝ kutl lǝbi ningi nǝ mǝ'ka ni.
Nǝs ɗami nǝ kǝmsi u, is gop bosi' kundǝlǝni di ɓǝtl taka, is gop utti alkama swa ge' mali.
Nǝlucilu, saman atlu nǝsi lǝbi uwai, amma is yen luwon multisǝn is kǝndǝ shilǝn is ussu in mul pǝkkǝn u as tǝla kundǝlǝni atǝn tisǝni.
Is ɓaɓatl zhim domi taka is zaki age' mali, age' cini a si tǝngǝl ul jakkǝ kundǝlǝni, is tlǝl lulut ki tǝn kina ki kundǝlǝni tǝn kina yetǝl. Is nga bigasi tya.
Amma nǝm mbǝci gelu unǝ dlǝlka pǝl dandle u, is jakǝn kundǝlǝni i gami te'ge' tisǝn, hal kundǝlǝni taman utti nuwai i kal kundǝlǝni kan tatlti gaki tlitti ki bǝs ki mal.
Amma mi'kǝndǝ dlomi lyami sǝ'tlwa mi' ginǝ ge'lu kǝndǝ mbalǝn i, ɓas pe' ge' mali as kitǝli.
Amma nǝ bal mul kǝndǝ dlom ki Loma lyami tǝ pekǝl Bulus su, in nge. I' balsi zhil i' ulsisu mulnǝ man malu as ndaswa ge' malu as lǝ tǝn bigasi,
Gen ne is to'tǝn ancin ki kunɗǝlǝn genne tǝn use ki kundǝlǝnisi. Nǝnǝgu is mbǝci lau.
